name: normet
description: Meteorological normalisation (de-weathering) of air-quality time series and synthetic control for intervention effects: Monte-Carlo weather resampling, emission and meteorological decompositions, trends, events, in-context normalisation and trajectory-based receptor maps.
suggestedPrompts: Inspect my air-quality CSV and propose the meteorological predictors for de-weathering
Run a de-weathering of NO2, judge the model's held-out fit, and show the normalised series
Run a synthetic control for a clean-air-zone intervention and check the placebo tests
